title: Караоке-тест
caption:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 95. key is C, and scale is minor. Darkwave, Synth-pop. Global Emotional Progression: The piece opens with a haunting, isolated atmosphere, builds into a driving, claustrophobic pulse of urban mystery, and culminates in a grand, cinematic sense of lonely, nocturnal vastness. Application Scenarios & Imagery: A solo drive through a neon-drenched metropolis at 3 AM; walking through a rain-slicked, industrial district under flickering lights. Sonics & Production Profile: A wide, cavernous soundstage with a deep, heavy reverb; a saturated low-end that fills the stereo field; crisp, gated high-frequency accents; and thick, analog synth textures that feel both warm and haunting.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female), haunting, breathy, and ethereal mezzo-soprano. Vocal Style: The delivery is airy and intimate during the verses, almost whispering into the microphone, transitioning to a more powerful, layered, and slightly more urgent delivery in the choruses. Harmony/Backing Vocals: Wide, layered harmonies in the chorus to create a 'ghostly choir' effect with significant stereo width. Vocal FX: Deep hall reverb, a light 1/8th note delay, and subtle compression to maintain presence in the dense mix.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering): Primary: Thick, layered analog synth pads provide a constant, haunting atmosphere; a heavy, driving sawtooth bassline provides the rhythmic pulse; a steady, gated 4/4 kick-snare beat establishes the urban core. Secondary: Shimmering 16th-note arpeggios enter during the pre-chorus to build tension; a second layer of aggressive sawtooth synths and a heavier, processed snare enter in the chorus; a high-frequency, ethereal synth lead melody emerges in the final chorus to provide a melodic contrast. Groove & Foundation Progression: The track starts with a minimalist, brooding pulse in the intro and the first verse. The pre-chorus introduces a driving, syncopated arpeggio that creates a sense of forward motion. The chorus transitions into a full, heavy, industrial-influenced groove with a prominent, driving kick drum. Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: A subtle crackling vinyl texture and a low-frequency room hum are present in the intro. Reverse-reverb swells lead into the pre-chorus to create a sense of anticipation. Heavy sidechain compression is applied to the synth pads to create a 'pumping' sensation. The chorus features a wide stereo spread on the high-frequency elements and a dense, cavernous reverb tail.
lyrics:
[intro]

[verse]
Неон дрожит на мокрой коже старых улиц,
Холодный пульс в бетонных венах города бьется.
Тень густая, как старый аспальт под ногами,
Город в тени свой мрачный секрет заберёт.

[pre-chorus]
Слышишь, как дышит бетон?
Слышишь, как бьется в нем тон?

[chorus]
Ночный город — магнит из пустоты,
В объятьях теней сгорают все мечты.
Сквозь призму стекла, сквозь холодный туман,
Ты — лишь частица в немых глубинах.

[verse]
Стеклянный шепот, сталь и вечная тишина,
В глазах чужих — ночная муть и серая пыль.

[chorus]
Ночный город — магнит из пустоты,
В объятьях теней сгорают все мечты.
Сквозь призму стекла, сквозь холодный туман,
Ты — лишь частица в немых глубинах.
